description:
Enterprise-grade, extensible chart component framework for .NET 8.0 applications.
			Provides configurable, metadata-driven chart rendering with support for multiple
			chart types, templates, and interactive visualization capabilities. Enables dynamic
			chart generation and widget orchestration through Rule-Based Access Control (RBAC)
			to manage chart visibility, behavior, personalization, and access based on user
			roles, groups, and individual identities.

			Supports dashboard-driven visualization, reusable widget configurations, and
			dynamic filter-based data retrieval across distributed enterprise systems.
			Designed using Clean Architecture and Ports and Adapters principles to ensure
			scalability, maintainability, and seamless integration across Web APIs,
			microservices, and modular enterprise platforms.

			Includes extensibility for custom chart templates, dispatcher-based execution,
			and adapter-driven data sources, enabling organizations to build consistent,
			secure, and high-performance analytical dashboards.
releaseNotes:
Version 0.0.1
			- Initial release of the Charts Component Application Framework.
			- Introduced metadata-driven and configurable chart rendering.
			- Implemented support for multiple chart templates and visualization types.
			- Enabled dynamic chart generation through dispatcher-based query execution.
			- Added RBAC-based chart visibility, personalization, and behavior control.
			- Introduced dashboard and widget orchestration capabilities.
			- Enabled widget lifecycle operations including creation, configuration,
			persistence, and deletion.
			- Supported dynamic filter-driven chart data retrieval.
			- Added extensibility for custom chart templates and adapters.
			- Designed using Clean Architecture and Ports and Adapters principles.
			- Integrated observability and telemetry context support for enterprise tracing.
			- Enabled seamless integration across microservices and enterprise data sources.
title: ND Charts Framework
